reference: Geehan et al. (2006), MNRAS 366, 996, Table 2, (M/L_R)_d=3.3 column
geometry: Spherical Hernquist bulge, infinitesimally thin exponential disk, central point mass
notes: Parameters are fixed to the rounded published values, not fitted to the Corbelli rotation curve.
This simplified literature baseline has no separately resolved gas component. The fitted residual can absorb gas and baryonic-model error; it is not a uniquely measured dark-matter distribution.
The source model adopts 784 kpc; the rotation-curve source adopts 785 kpc. Published values are retained without a distance rescaling.
This combines Corbelli's observations with Geehan's baryonic baseline; it does not reproduce Corbelli's fitted Sersic bulge, finite-thickness disk and measured gas decomposition.
